intent.purpose: Exploit exact qA histogram information discarded by EX5 HPADJ20 two-tier compression while preserving the same ordered-triple population.

exact_combinatorial_preflight.multiplicity_identity: For support s>0, sum_q hist[a,s,q] = C(3,s) C(a-1,s-1); for (a,s)=(0,0) it is 1.

structural_dominance.hpadj20_two_tier_rule: Keep exact qA_min multiplicity; assign every nonminimum tuple the exact second-smallest qA as a common lower bound.
structural_dominance.full_histogram_rule: Keep every distinct exact qA with its exact multiplicity.
structural_dominance.pointwise_fact: For every nonminimum tuple, qA_exact >= qA_second, with strict inequality on tuples above the second qA level.
structural_dominance.survivor_monotonicity: For a fixed x4 parity capacity multiset, N_r(q)=#{cap>=q} is nonincreasing in q.
structural_dominance.lp_dominance_argument: Split each HPADJ20 second-tier ratio bin into exact-qA sub-bins. Their total capacity is unchanged and each refined survivor coefficient is no larger. Any refined feasible allocation maps to a coarse HPADJ20 allocation of the same mass with objective at least as large. Therefore every refined cell optimum is <= the HPADJ20 cell optimum.
structural_dominance.strictness_reason_not_yet_proven: Threshold collapse or LP selection can make higher-qA distinctions inactive even though 182 classes contain more than two qA levels.

next_exact_gate.reason: EX5 already has an exact-head HPADJ20 heavy replay active; this MAIN preflight retains the independent strengthening without duplicating that compute.
